statement: Version 1.81 adds new bonuses from Rift 41 to Rift 46 giving two huge new buffs.
Rift 41 awards Construction Mastery which combines every building you've built into bonuses like refinery speed and damage percent and build speed percent.
Rift 46 introduces Ruby cards: new five-star cards giving even more bonuses.
Five-star cards need a crazy amount of cards farmed and will take an insane amount of time.
Build up card chance because five-star card farming is a long haul.
Mobs in the high rifts are very tough with health in the trillions.
When pushing for 5 million kills run the prayer Fibers of Absence (garbled).
Run the big green bubble Kill per Kill when pushing 5 million kills.
You will almost never hit multi-kill as long as you have enough damage for the kill cap.
Fiber prayer and Kill per Kill can raise your kill count up to 20-30k.
Characters should run Mantis from Divinity and the Times to Kill lab note to make rift pushing faster.
Book Siege Breaker coins and the Divine Knight orb and the Elemental Sorcerer portal to increase duration so you can progress.
A map needed to progress with the Elemental Sorcerer requires a 60 reps score.
It took about 250 billion max damage with 6x crit damage and 200% crit chance to clear the 60 reps map.
Go to the tiny platform next to the rift NPC drop the portal and press auto so the tornado ricochets back and forth increasing damage substantially.
Even after a while he still struggled to reach Rift 46.
A new limited edition shop launched alongside Ruby cards.
The limited shop gave the Crescent Moon pendant which gives plus one slab.
The limited shop offered 30 big XP balloons for skill XP and 8 Cosmic candies.
The limited shop offered one free Four Star card (fire?).
The limited shop also had the Honker chat ring.
Elite Class swap tokens finally let you swap your Elite classes.
The token only swaps the Elite Class of your main class: Bubonic Conjuror becomes Elemental Sorcerer; you cannot change an Archer into Warrior or Warrior into Mage.
You can buy 10 five-star cardifiers; they are pricey but give a quick boost to starting your five-star card farm.
First five-star cards he suggests are Poop and Demogini (garbled) for increased crystal spawn chance.
Also five-star the nightmare bosses so you don't have to spend a million keys getting them to five star.
Update adds super bits with bonuses to bits per achievement and mobile stat increaser and library checkouts and plant evolutions.
A new super bit called MSA totalizer (miniature soul apparatus) is the easy totem made from the automation arm in construction in World 3.
MSA totalizer gives more bonuses for your highest wave in Tower Defense; overkilling your TD score is worth it.
Tower Defense score rewards damage percent and sailing speed and cooking speed.
Cooking speed bonus seems a separate multiplier as he tripled his cooking speed.
New gaming box The Immortal Snail is a late game grind.
Immortal Snail unlocks a new gaming currency called mail based on a daily reset with its own independent timer.
You cannot cheese mail with chemical plant or log to progress time.
Works like Maple Story Star Force: a success chance to gain a star that decreases as you upgrade and a percent chance to reset progress.
He assumes with enough time you'll be able to push red bits in about a week.
Lately there are many late game updates but he's okay with it; they should help the 99s a bit more.
